BlockingProcess.description: An OS-reported application using a blocked file. This is diagnostic, never authority to stop it.

name.description: Native application or service display name.

pid.description: Process identifier observed at failure time; it may be reused later.

CleanupSizeAccounting.description: How a handler's completed selections contribute to a human-facing cleanup summary.

oneOf.description: Processed content has a byte estimate; missing estimates remain unknown.
Snapshot groups share storage and must be counted separately from byte estimates.

FileUsage.description: Best-effort native explanation for one file which could not be removed.

path.description: Display-only path of the exact blocked file, including a child of a selected directory.

processes.description: Processes observed at failure time; an empty list means the OS could not identify them.

GroupExecutionReport.description: 一个计划组的执行报告。

error.description: Handler 调用整体失败说明。

failure.description: Original structured handler failure; `error` retains the existing display text.

result.description: Handler 返回的清理结果；调用整体失败时为 `None`。

size_accounting.description: Registered handler accounting, retained with the report for later display.

HandlerCleanResult.description: Aggregate and per-selection cleanup results from one handler invocation.

outcomes.description: Per-selection outcomes, including partial effects and not-attempted work.

reclaimed_bytes.description: Known processed-size subtotal, not measured freed disk space.

space_changes.description: Volume observations around distinct, non-overlapping cleanup batches. A shared batch is reported once, not once per selected item or task.

unknown_reclaimed_items.description: Items with confirmed or uncertain effects whose processed-size estimate is unknown. None means the handler did not report size completeness (including older plugins).

IoFailure.description: A portable classification plus the unmodified native error code.

kind.description: Machine-readable category; display text is never used for authorization decisions.

oneOf.description: The exact resource is absent.
OS access rights were insufficient.
Another process holds an incompatible handle.
The underlying volume is read-only.
An OS policy prevents the requested operation.
The operation was cancelled.
The operation exceeded its deadline.
The selected identity or its containing boundary changed.
A symbolic link, reparse point, or mount violates the allowed traversal boundary.
A resource budget was exhausted.
A backend/protocol operation is unsupported.
An error with no more specific portable classification.

ItemExecution.description: Exact per-selection execution evidence used by reports and execution journals.

failure.description: Failure or interruption that prevented full completion.

item_id.description: Original selected item identity within its task.

reclaimed_estimate.description: Known estimate of actual processed content; None means unknown, not zero.

reclaimed_lower_bound.description: Known processed-size subtotal when the complete estimate is unknown; otherwise zero.

status.description: Observable outcome of this selected unit.

ItemExecutionStatus.description: Handler 的清理结果。 Outcome of one originally selected unit; this is distinct from the operation's terminal state.

oneOf.description: All eligible work in the selected unit completed.
The selected resource had already disappeared; its additional estimate is zero.
Some effects occurred before a failure or cancellation.
An attempted operation failed before any known effects.
Work was dispatched but its effects could not be confirmed; never retry without reconciliation.
No destructive work was attempted, for example after cancellation.

ItemFailure.description: 单个清理项的执行失败。

authorization.description: Result of an authorization attempt for this item, distinct from its original IO failure.

file_usage.description: Best-effort native file usage at failure time, absent on unsupported platforms.

io_failure.description: Structured native failure; display strings are not retry decisions.

OperationStopReason.description: Why an operation stopped before finishing its requested scope.

oneOf.description: The caller explicitly requested cancellation.
The original operation's execution deadline was reached.

PermissionOutcome.description: Stable outcomes reported by a native backend, without interpreting localized messages.

oneOf.description: An actual operation or backend handshake established the capability.
The native backend explicitly reported refusal.
The caller cancelled the operation.
The authorization deadline elapsed.
The OS requires an explicit change in system settings.
The installed helper could not be found.
The helper identity or installation permissions are not trusted.
The installed helper predates the required scoped identity protocol.
Authorization did not complete; the native error does not establish a narrower cause.
This operation needs an interactive authorization context.
The backend or protocol cannot perform this operation.
A system policy prevents the operation.
The target volume cannot be modified.

authorization.description: Native authorization result, when this failure came from an authorization attempt.

code.description: 适合程序判断的稳定错误代码。

io_failure.description: Structured native error, when the failure comes from an OS operation.

message.description: 面向用户的英文错误说明。

VolumeSpaceChange.description: Observed volume free-space change, separate from per-item processed-size estimates. Concurrent filesystem activity can contribute to this change.

error.description: Why measurement was unavailable; this does not change the deletion outcome.

freeBytesAfter.description: Free bytes on the same filesystem after the batch command has exited.

freeBytesBefore.description: Free filesystem bytes immediately before the batch, including reserved free blocks.

scope.description: Human-readable operation scope, such as a snapshot configuration name.

description: 一次清理计划的执行报告。

cancelled.description: 是否因协作式取消提前结束。

operation_failures.description: Operation-wide finalization failures, separate from already committed item/group results.

stop_reason.description: Cause of interrupted execution, preserving completed per-item effects.

title: ExecutionReport
